Res.Caption: Transport Booking Requested
Res.FullDescription: The date/time the Port Transport Provider has been advised to pick up the goods for delivery to the consignee. This will default to the time the Import Delivery Cartage Advice was printed.

Res.Caption: Actual Delivery
Res.FullDescription: The actual date/time the goods have been delivered to the Consignee.

Res.Caption: Delivery Labor
Res.FullDescription: The Delivery Labor Charge Rate. This Job Service Rate autorates sell for the charge code in Registry>AutoRating>Charge Codes>Destination>Destination Labor Service.

Res.Caption: Delivery Labor Duration
Res.FullDescription: The Delivery Labor Duration.

Res.Caption: Delivery Required By
Res.FullDescription: The date/time the goods are required to be delivered to the Consignee by. Generally this is the latest time the goods can be Delivered.

Res.Caption: Truck Wait Charge
Res.FullDescription: The Delivery Truck Wait Charge Rate. This Job Service Rate autorates sell for the charge code in Registry>AutoRating>Charge Codes>Destination>Truck Wait Time at Destination Service.

Res.Caption: Delivery Truck Wait Duration
Res.FullDescription: The duration the truck was waiting before being able to move into the delivery location.

Res.Caption: Truck Wait Charge
Res.FullDescription: The Pickup Truck Wait Charge Rate. This Job Service Rate autorates sell for the charge code in Registry>AutoRating>Charge Codes>Origin>Truck Wait Time at Origin Service.

Res.Caption: Pickup Truck Wait Duration
Res.FullDescription: The duration the truck was waiting to move to the pickup location.

Res.Caption: Estimated Pickup Date
Res.FullDescription: The estimated pickup date.

Res.Caption: Export Statement
Res.FullDescription: The Export Statement that will be printed on relevant bills.

Res.Caption: FCL Available Date
Res.FullDescription: Enter the first day the cargo is available for collection at the pick up point for this Full Container Load (FCL).

Res.Caption: Delivery Port Transport Drop Mode
Res.FullDescription: The Port Transport Drop Mode equipment necessary for Delivery.

Res.Caption: Pickup Port Transport Drop Mode
Res.FullDescription: The Drop mode / Equipment Required for the Port Transport for Pickup purposes.

Res.Caption: FCL Storage Date
Res.FullDescription: Enter the first day on which storage will apply to the cargo at the point of collection.

Res.Caption: Is Contingency Release
Res.FullDescription: Release shipment on contingency

Res.Caption: Storage Charge
Res.FullDescription: The Storage Charge Rate. This Job Service Rate autorates sell for the charge code in Registry>AutoRating>Charge Codes>Destination>Destination Storage Service.

Res.Caption: Storage Time
Res.FullDescription: The storage duration on delivery.

Res.Caption: Available Date
Res.FullDescription: The actual date/time the goods have been delivered to the Consignee.

Res.Caption: Override Available and Storage Consolidation Dates
Res.FullDescription: Allows you to override the Available and Storage dates for this shipment.

Res.Caption: Storage Commences Date
Res.FullDescription: The actual date/time the goods have been delivered to the Consignee.

Res.Caption: Delivery Local Transport Company
Res.FullDescription: The Delivery Local Transport Company.

Res.Caption: Pickup Local Transport Company
Res.FullDescription: The Local Transport Company who is picking up the goods.

Res.Caption: Order References
Res.FullDescription: The order references - if any - for this movement.

Res.Caption: Transport Booking Requested
Res.FullDescription: The date/time the documents have been sent to the carrier to authorize the pick up of the goods from the origin. This will default to the time the Export Pickup Cartage Advice was printed.

Res.Caption: Actual Pickup
Res.FullDescription: The actual date/time the goods have been picked up from the origin by the carrier.

Res.Caption: Pickup Labor
Res.FullDescription: The Pickup Labor Charge Rate. This Job Service Rate autorates sell for the charge code in Registry>AutoRating>Charge Codes>Origin>Origin Labor Service.

Res.Caption: Pickup Labor Duration
Res.FullDescription: The labor duration necessary for Pickup.

Res.Caption: Pickup Required By
Res.FullDescription: The date/time the goods are required to be picked up from the origin by the carrier. Generally this is the latest time the goods can be picked up.

Res.Caption: Air Waybill Dimensions
Res.FullDescription: Governs how the volume and dimensions are defaulted to the 'Nature and Quantity of Goods' section on the Air Waybill.
